description: This Java class defines constants and utility methods for request-response APIs within the Eclipse Hono project. It provides mechanisms to create AMQP messages for responses and errors, and declares various string constants for message fields and properties.

classes.name: RequestResponseApiConstants
classes.description: An abstract class containing constants and utility methods for creating request-response messages conforming to a specific pattern used in the Eclipse Hono project.

methods.name: getAmqpReply
methods.description: Creates an AMQP message as a reply containing the response payload, headers, and correlation information based on a provided EventBusMessage.

methods.name: getErrorMessage
methods.description: Creates an error AMQP message with a status code and optional error description, correlating it with an original request message.
